Title: Product Vision Alignment
Detail_lesson: How does your product team ensure that the technical vision aligns with business objectives?
CustomInstruction: Name the artefact that actually holds the alignment — a document, an OKR, a roadmap — and the last time it was wrong. Say who noticed.

Title: Developer Experience Impact
Detail_lesson: When making product decisions, how do you measure and prioritize the impact on developer experience?
CustomInstruction: Describe a trade you made between shipping speed and developer experience, and who paid for it.

Title: Technical Debt Prioritization
Detail_lesson: How does your product team work with engineering to prioritize technical debt alongside new features?
CustomInstruction: Give the shared language you use with engineering to weigh debt against features. If you do not have one, describe what the arguments sound like instead.

Title: API Design Philosophy
Detail_lesson: What role does the product team play in API design decisions?
CustomInstruction: Name one API decision product owned and one engineering owned. Say how that split was agreed, and whether it holds under deadline pressure.

Title: Developer Tool Investment
Detail_lesson: How do you build the business case for investing in internal developer tools and platforms?
CustomInstruction: Build the case in three numbers. Then name the number you cannot get, and how you argue without it.

Title: Documentation Standards
Detail_lesson: What standards does your product team set for technical documentation?
CustomInstruction: Name who writes documentation, who reviews it, and what triggers an update. If nothing triggers an update, say that plainly.

Title: Feature Flag Strategy
Detail_lesson: How does your product team leverage feature flags for progressive rollouts?
CustomInstruction: Say who can turn a flag on in production and how flags get removed afterwards. The cleanup is the interesting part.

Title: Developer Onboarding
Detail_lesson: What role does product play in optimizing the developer onboarding experience?
CustomInstruction: Give your time from joining to first meaningful change, and how you measure it. Then name the step that eats the most of it.

Title: Platform vs Feature Balance
Detail_lesson: How do you balance platform improvements against feature development?
CustomInstruction: Give this quarter's actual split between platform and feature work, not the intended one. Then say what would make you change it.

Title: Developer Feedback Loops
Detail_lesson: What mechanisms does your product team use to gather and act on developer feedback?
CustomInstruction: Trace one piece of developer feedback all the way to a roadmap change, and say how long it took.

Title: Security in Product Design
Detail_lesson: How early does your product team engage with security considerations?
CustomInstruction: Name the point in your process where security first appears. Then say what would have to happen for it to appear earlier.

Title: Performance Requirements
Detail_lesson: How does your product team define and communicate performance requirements?
CustomInstruction: State one performance target the way a user would experience it, and name who agreed to it. Targets without an owner do not count.

Title: Developer Advocacy Metrics
Detail_lesson: What metrics does your product team track to measure the success of developer advocacy initiatives?
CustomInstruction: Name one advocacy metric that changed a product decision. If none has, say what you are actually measuring for.

Title: Technical Feasibility Assessment
Detail_lesson: How does your product team assess technical feasibility before committing to features?
CustomInstruction: Describe the cheapest signal you get before committing to a feature, and the last time you committed without it.

Title: API Versioning Strategy
Detail_lesson: How does your product team approach API versioning and deprecation?
CustomInstruction: Give the rule that decides when something can be deprecated, and the longest you have carried something you wanted to kill.

Title: Developer Community Building
Detail_lesson: What role does product play in building and nurturing the developer community?
CustomInstruction: Name who owns the community relationship on an ordinary Tuesday afternoon, and what happens when that person is on leave.

Title: Internal Tool Prioritization
Detail_lesson: How do you prioritize internal developer tools against external features?
CustomInstruction: Name one internal investment you funded ahead of a customer-facing feature, and how you defended it.

Title: Developer Success Metrics
Detail_lesson: How does your product team define and measure developer success?
CustomInstruction: Name one metric you track and the business outcome you claim it predicts. Then say how confident you honestly are in that link.

Title: Technical Partnership Model
Detail_lesson: How does your product team partner with platform and infrastructure teams?
CustomInstruction: Name one thing platform and infrastructure teams need from you that you routinely fail to give them on time.

Title: Innovation Time Allocation
Detail_lesson: How does your product team support engineering innovation time?
CustomInstruction: Describe how exploration actually gets scheduled — sprint capacity, a dedicated week, nothing formal — and what happens to it when delivery pressure rises.
